notes:
The sheet is numbered 32. It continues the proof of F minus G = F′ minus G′ by numbered inclusions 1°) and 2°). For the second inclusion it chooses the smallest A in F^{A′}, argues that A lies in F minus G, invokes equality of the two strata attached to A, and then excludes A′ from G. A vertical marginal note says “va se simplifier, cf plus bas.” The page next abandons a b)⇒c) argument and starts a b⇔c argument using the common open complement U and ordered index sets I and I′. It ends “On a” in the middle of that discussion. No date appears.

[TXT033-unprimed-parenthesis] The phrase following the heavily traced relation between A′ and A has the unprimed “d’où A∈F.” H supplies A′, which would state the desired consequence directly, but no prime is visible in the enlarged manuscript parenthesis. The literal A is retained. From the preceding assumptions A∈F and A′=A, A′∈F follows by equality substitution; that elementary implication was checked separately and did not change the ink. At the preceding relation itself, R1/R2 favour an older membership-shaped sign overwritten by equality, while R3 retains membership as a possible final reading. Main gives the overwrite interpretation first because the two horizontal bars are much thicker than the curved connector and short interior bar, but preserves a live membership alternative. The older sign remains membership/subset uncertain. This is an ink-layer decision, not a repair from the expected equality proof.

[M033-strata-inclusion] The manuscript uses A′°(F′)⊂A°(F′) to infer A=A′. As a conditional local argument, this follows if each named stratum is nonempty and strata with distinct labels are disjoint: a point of the first stratum belongs to both, contradicting disjointness if the labels differ. This checks that elementary step under those hypotheses; it does not establish all figure or stratum hypotheses for this page.

[M033-later-lemma] The equality A°(F)=A°(F′) is accompanied by “cf lemme plus bas” and an interlinear weakening “il suffirait F′≪F.” The visible baseline relation is F′ preceq F. The sufficiency of that weaker relation is carried as the author's claim and reference; no later page has been read to prove it here. No i.e. or sachant is supplied from H.

[TXT033-cancelled-block] The entire upper addition “On suppose b) i.e. φ induit …” is preserved with its insertion leader and the diagonal strokes across the abandoned b)⇒c) draft. The short curve before Soit belongs to that leader and is not an extra opening parenthesis. “ouverte,” the old dans/la layer and the cancelled de following élément remain in the text. The final Prouvons equality is on a baseline beneath the five oblique strokes; its possible inclusion in the paragraph-level cancellation is marked explicitly, rather than resolved from the abandoned proof's content.

[TXT033-small-marks] The initial cancellation's rightward arrow-like extension, both worked superscripts in the bracketed formula, the full margin rule, two small pale stroke clusters to its right, the attachment to the suffirait note and the pale left-arrow-shaped trace above the final live et are preserved. The pale marks' hand, function and possible erasure are not secure. The bien word has an extra low stroke whose state is uncertain between underline and cancellation. None of these marks is assigned a mathematical role merely to make the argument parse.
